label: Finding-19
title: watchtowr-itw: Claim omits watchTowr's own qualifier: no successful attempt, and sprayed exploits mostly do not work
description: Knott: 'Whilst nobody has been successful to date' (SecurityWeek) and 'The exploits being sprayed indiscriminately either don't work at all, test for timing-based differences, or crash the target'. Without this the claim reads as more than attempts.
